effect.shortEffect: Lowers Special Defense of all Pokémon except itself.
effect.full: The power of the Pokémon’s ruinous beads lowers the Sp. Def stats of all Pokémon except itself.

french.sv: Le pouvoir des perles qui appellent le fléau affaiblit\nla Défense Spéciale de tous les autres Pokémon.

english.sv: The power of the Pokémon's ruinous beads lowers the Sp. Def stats of all Pokémon except itself.

japanese.sv: 災厄を　呼ぶ　勾玉の力で 自分以外の　特防が　弱くなる。
